t: Fire broke out in the French Concession. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. 8 houses destroyed. General alarm given.
Fire broke out in Nos. 48 - 49, Shanse Road. Origin unknown. Four houses destroyed. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out in a house, occupied by Mr. Coutts, on Bubbling Well Road. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out in a house in the Louza village. Caused by overheating a stove. Three houses destroyed. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at 531, Chekiang Road. Caused by placing a foot-warmer in a bed. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at 334, Hankow Road. "Cause unknown." Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police with extincteurs. No alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 382, North Soochow Road. "Origin unknown." Five houses destroyed. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out in New Seward Road. Origin unknown. Part of a joss-house, a stack of straw, and 5 houses damaged. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No 4, Canton Road. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out in No. 104, New Seward Road, in the cook-house. Three houses destroyed. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 404, Chekiang Road. Caused through occupant smoking in bed. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the Police. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 215, Honan Road. Caused by embers from a stove. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 203, Nanzing Road. Caused through the overheating of a stove-pipe. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police, and inmates. "No general alarm given."
Fire broke out at 147, Hankow Road. Caused through smoking in bed. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out in a godown, No. 828, Pekin Road, "Origin unknown." Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at 340, Tiendong Road, through upsetting a kerosine oil lamp. Three houses destroyed. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out in unoccupied house, No. 383, North Soochow Road. No. 383 completely burnt and 2 adjoining houses damaged. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 354, Szechuen Road. "Origin unknown." Damage slight. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out in an alleyway off North Honan Road. Origin unknown. One house and a quantity of firewood burnt. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

Fire broke out at 42, Shanse Road, through dropping a lighted match among some cotton. Forty houses destroyed in Shanse Road, and five partially burnt in Kiukiang Road. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. "General alarm given"
Fire broke out at 305, Tsingpoo Road, through some coal falling from a stove. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 269, Shantung Road. Caused by upsetting a kerosine oil lamp. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. [blank in original] Shantung Road. Origin unknown. Six houses destroyed and two damaged. Extinguished by Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 770, Kiukiang Road. Origin unknown. Six houses destroyed. Extinguished by Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at Baron de Gunzburg's house, Markham Road, through overheating a stove-pipe in the cook-house. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the servants. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 16, North Soochow Road. Origin unknown. Sixteen houses damaged. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 628, Ningpo Road. Caused through some fire falling from a stove. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

Fire broke out at 123, New Seward Road. Caused through carelessness in a chin-chin joss affair. One house burnt and one damaged. Extinguished by Police and inmates, before the Fire Brigade arrived. General alarm give[?].
Fire broke out at No. 1001, Broadway Road. Caused by burning incense under the bed. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 693, Tiendong Road. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out in an unoccupied house in North Shanse Road. Origin unknown. Five houses destroyed. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. "General alarm given."
The chimney of the Customs Club, Whangpoo Road, caught fire. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and neighbours. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 955, Nankin Road. Damage trifling. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 318, Chekiang Road. Damage trifling. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Police. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 1009, Pekin Road. Five houses destroyed. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 1178, New Seward Road. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 60, Shantung Road. Damage trifling. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 1290, New Seward Road. Damage trifling. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 1288, New Seward Road, through upsetting a kerosine oil lamp. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 524, Yunnan Road. Damage trifling. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 178, North Honan Road. Fourteen houses were destroyed. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at Messrs. Russell & Co.'s Silk Filature, Louza Village. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. Damage "heavy." General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 357, Szechuen Road, in the cook-house. Damage trifling. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 24, Chapoo Road. Incendiarism suspected. Extinguished by Police and inmates, before the Fire Brigade arrived. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 29, North Soochow Road. Staircase damaged. Origin unknown. Extinguished by inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 125, North Soochow Road, through upsetting a kerosine oil lamp. Damage trifling, but a man was seriously injured. Extinguished by inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 129, Foochow Road, caused through sparks from a stove. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 6, North Soochow Road. Cause "Incendiarism." One house destroyed and three damaged. Two Portuguese arrested and charged. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out in a village off the Yangtszepoo Road, out of limits. The Fire Brigade did not attend. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 116, Foochow Road. Caused through burning joss-paper. Twelve houses destroyed. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 286, Tientsin Road. Caused by an opium-lamp on the bed. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 144, Derpoe Road. Cause "Incendiarism." Damage slight. Three men arrested and charged at the Mixed Court. Extinguished by inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out in the French Concession. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 1, Saunders' Compound. Caused through the overheating of a stove-pipe. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at a house on Cemetery Road. Origin unknown. 53 houses destroyed. Extinguished by Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 6, Woosung Road, through burning joss-sticks near the window-curtain. Only the curtain burnt. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at a house in an alleyway off Foochow Road. Caused through a bed-curtain catching fire. Twelve houses destroyed. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at 158, Fuhkien Road. Caused by upsetting a kerosine oil lamp. A boy was seriously burnt. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out in a newly erected house in an alleyway off Yunnan Road. Four houses destroyed. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 466, Chekiang Road. Eight houses destroyed. Origin unknown. Extinguished by Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 1, Ningpo Road. Caused by some burning tobacco from a pipe falling amongst some straw. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 329, Tientsin Road. 43 houses destroyed. Origin unknown. Extinguished by Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out among a quantity of wood, stored in the back premises of 59/60, Nankin Road. Damage trifling. Origin unknown. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 199, Kiangse Road. 3 houses destroyed. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 22, Nanzing Road, through upsetting a kerosine oil lamp. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 276, Chekiang Road. Caused through burning joss-paper. Three shops destroyed and one damaged. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
Firm [printed; sic for 'Fire'] broke out at No. 17½, Yuenfoong Road, through some cinders falling from a stove. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
Fire broke out at No. 496, Nankin Road, through overheating a stove. Damage trifling. Extinguished by Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
